description: The app's Session mode: how long it records and the two rules that are the app's own rather than the algorithms package's. Read by session_reference.py; SessionConfigTest fails if Session.kt differs. Every HRV and breathing rule (minimum windows, coverage, peak share) comes from algorithms/config.json, not from here.
tail_note: After the last recorded sample the detector runs on for tail_s so that beats inside the session but located late are kept: a search-back beat can be located up to 1.66 RR after it, and HIST_S (4 s) is the furthest the detector looks back. Only beats whose position lies inside the session are used, and only samples inside it.
hr_note: Session heart rate = 60 / median of the intervals between consecutive detected beats with no lost samples between them (flagged and searched-back beats included: their timing is good enough for a median). Withheld below hr_min_intervals intervals, the same count as MIN_BEATS_FOR_HRV in tp2_config.json. Not validated as a session measure.
breathing_note: Breathing rate = median of the fused rates of the 32 s windows (algorithms/config.json breathing.window_s) starting every breathing_step_s in the session, as in the BIDMC validation. Withheld when fewer than breathing_min_windows windows give a rate. That count is the app's choice and was not tuned or validated: the per-window rules are the validated part.
